policy.acceptance: At least 5% lower mean QLIKE; positive issuer-level improvement in >=70% of issuers; at least 30 events and 5 issuers; no missing eligible outcomes
policy.cost_policy: Prediction accuracy only, no executable profit claim; incremental inference budget zero. Record incurred inference cost or explicit unknown.
policy.historical_policy: Historical model outputs are engineering smoke evidence only; prospective timestamped predictions required
policy.hypothesis: Unresolved earnings uncertainty increases next-five-session realised variance
policy.outcome: mean squared close-to-close log return over next five exchange sessions after prediction cutoff
policy.score_prompt: Using only supplied issuer text, score unresolved forward earnings uncertainty from 0 to 1; return score and exact supporting quote. Do not use outside knowledge.
